Loss report: concourse -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment (Forgejo does not document environment)
[lost] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/step/deploy ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config, input_mapping) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment.approval: configure required reviewers on the environment in repository settings
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy step.action: actions/checkout step (Concourse fetches the repository with the get of the job and GHA does not; the depth param of the get maps to fetch-depth)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/step/deploy step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[native] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
